crosswalks.label: Project Management Specialists
crosswalks.rationale: Project Management Specialists is a bounded occupational baseline for Project Manager; AXM profession identity/authority/maturity remain separate.

findings.summary: Project Management must keep coordination, schedule and delivery status separate from specialist acceptance, product authority and constitutional merge authority.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make delivery-status-versus-technical-acceptance, scope-drift and authority boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Project Manager reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent institutional authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No role label, package, model capability, repository permission or coordination function creates constitutional, product, professional or institutional authority.
